verses.sloka: सुमाली वरलब्धांस्तु ज्ञात्वा चैतान्निशाचरान् ।उदतिष्ठद्भयं त्यक्त्वा सानुगः स रसातलात् ।। ७.११.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: sumālī varalabdhāṁstu jñātvā caitānniśācarān ।udatiṣṭhadbhayaṁ tyaktvā sānugaḥ sa rasātalāt ।। 7.11.1 ॥

translations.english: Sumali, having learned that these night-wanderers had obtained boons, rose up from Rasatala with his followers, abandoning all fear.
translations.hindi: उच्तरकादुड का नवा सर्ग समाप्त हुआ हन्छ” शवा दशस रण: , ०:== ग्रथात्रवीच्‌ छुनि राधः कथं ते अतरो वने । कीदशं तु तदा बल्ल स्तपस्तेपुसहाबलाः

verses.sloka: मारीचश्च प्रहस्तश्च विरूपाक्षो महोदरः ।उदतिष्ठन्सुसंरब्धाः सचिवास्तस्य रक्षसः ।। ७.११.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: mārīcaśca prahastaśca virūpākṣo mahodaraḥ ।udatiṣṭhansusaṁrabdhāḥ sacivāstasya rakṣasaḥ ।। 7.11.2 ॥

translations.english: Maricha, Prahasta, Virupaksha, and Mahodara, who were the greatly excited ministers of that Rakshasa (Sumali), also rose up.
translations.hindi: ह सुन, अगस्त्य जी प्रसन्न हो कर, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से बोले कि, उन तीवों भाइयों ने वहाँ ( गोकर्णाश्रम में ) जा, तपं के समस्त विधान किए

verses.sloka: सुमाली सचिवैः सार्धं वृतो राक्षसपुङ्गवैः ।अभिगम्य दशग्रीवं परिष्वज्येदमब्रवीत् ।। ७.११.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: sumālī sacivaiḥ sārdhaṁ vṛto rākṣasapuṅgavaiḥ ।abhigamya daśagrīvaṁ pariṣvajyedamabravīt ।। 7.11.3 ॥

translations.english: Sumali, surrounded by his ministers and other chief Rakshasas, approached Dashagriva, embraced him, and spoke these words.
translations.hindi: कुम्भकर्णं तपःधर्मे के नियमानुसार ( अथवा धर्समागे पर स्थित हो, ) गर्मी में अपने चारों ओर आग जला कर, पञ्चाम्ि तापता था

verses.sloka: दिष्ट्या ते वत्स सम्प्राप्तश्चिन्तितो ऽयं मनोरथः ।यस्त्वं त्रिभुवनश्रेष्ठाल्लब्धवान्वरमुत्तमम् ।। ७.११.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: diṣṭyā te vatsa samprāptaścintito 'yaṁ manorathaḥ ।yastvaṁ tribhuvanaśreṣṭhāllabdhavānvaramuttamam ।। 7.11.4 ॥

translations.english: Fortunately, O son, this cherished desire of yours has been achieved, as you have obtained an excellent boon from the best of the three worlds (Brahma).
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--चारों ओर चार श्रग्नियाँ और ऊपर से पाँचवाँ सूर्य- पञ्चाग्नि हैं |.) मेघाम्बुसिक्तो वर्षासु वीरासनमसेबत । नित्यं च शिशिरे काले जलमध्यप्रतिश्रयः

verses.sloka: यत्कृते च वयं लङ्कां त्यकत्वा याता रसातलम् ।तद्गतं नो महाबाहो महद्विष्णुकृतं भयम् ।। ७.११.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: yatkṛte ca vayaṁ laṅkāṁ tyakatvā yātā rasātalam ।tadgataṁ no mahābāho mahadviṣṇukṛtaṁ bhayam ।। 7.11.5 ॥

translations.english: O mighty-armed one, the great fear caused by Vishnu, for which we abandoned Lanka and went to Rasatala, has now departed from us.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार तप करते करते उसने दस हजार वर्षे बिता डाले । इतने दिनों तक वह सदेव तपःधस के नियमाबुसार तथा धर्से- मार्ग पर आरूढ़ रहा और केवल तप ही करता रहा

verses.sloka: असकृत्तद्भयाद्भीताः परित्यज्य स्वमालयम् ।विद्रुताः सहिताः सर्वे प्रविष्टाः स्म रसातलम् ।। ७.११.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: asakṛttadbhayādbhītāḥ parityajya svamālayam ।vidrutāḥ sahitāḥ sarve praviṣṭāḥ sma rasātalam ।। 7.11.6 ॥

translations.english: Frightened repeatedly by that fear, all of us together abandoned our own abode and fled, entering Rasatala.
translations.hindi: धमात्मा विभीषण नित्य धसे सें तत्पर ओर पवित्र हो पाँच हजार वर्षों तक एक पेर से भूमि पर खड़ा रह कर, तप करता रहा

verses.sloka: अस्मदीया च लङ्केयं नगरी राक्षसोचिता ।निवेशिता तव भ्रात्रा धनाध्यक्षेण धीमता ।। ७.११.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: asmadīyā ca laṅkeyaṁ nagarī rākṣasocitā ।niveśitā tava bhrātrā dhanādhyakṣeṇa dhīmatā ।। 7.11.7 ॥

translations.english: This city of Lanka, suitable for Rakshasas, was established by your intelligent brother, the lord of wealth (Kubera), and belongs to us.
translations.hindi: जब विभीषण जी का अनुष्ठान पूरा हुआ, तब अप्सराएं नाचने लगीं, फूलों की बघा हुई ओर देवता स्तुति करने लगे

verses.sloka: यदि नामात्र शक्यं स्यात्साम्ना दानेन वानघ ।तरसा वा महाबाहो प्रत्यानेतुं कृतं भवेत् ।। ७.११.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi nāmātra śakyaṁ syātsāmnā dānena vānagha ।tarasā vā mahābāho pratyānetuṁ kṛtaṁ bhavet ।। 7.11.8 ॥

translations.english: O sinless and mighty-armed one, if it is not possible to bring it back by conciliation or by gifts, then it should be done by force.
translations.hindi: A & पाठान्तरे-_“ल्नुभिताश्चापि? | फिर विभीषण पाँच हजार वर्षा तक ऊपर को दोनों भुजाएँ उठाए ओर ऊपर को सिर कर, सूर्य नारायण को देखता रहा ओर वेदपाठ करता रहा

verses.sloka: त्वं तु लङ्केश्वरस्तात भविष्यसि न संशयः ।त्वया राक्षसवंशो ऽयं निमग्नो ऽपि समुद्धृतः ।सर्वेषां नः प्रभुश्चैव भविष्यसि महाबल ।। ७.११.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: tvaṁ tu laṅkeśvarastāta bhaviṣyasi na saṁśayaḥ ।tvayā rākṣasavaṁśo 'yaṁ nimagno 'pi samuddhṛtaḥ ।sarveṣāṁ naḥ prabhuścaiva bhaviṣyasi mahābala ।। 7.11.9 ॥

translations.english: O dear and mighty one, you will undoubtedly be the lord of Lanka, for by you this Rakshasa race, even though submerged, has been uplifted, and you will indeed be the master of all of us.

verses.sloka: अथाब्रवीद्दशग्रीवो मातामहमुपस्थितम् ।वित्तेशो गुरुरस्माकं नार्हसे वक्तुमीदृशम् ।। ७.११.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: athābravīddaśagrīvo mātāmahamupasthitam ।vitteśo gururasmākaṁ nārhase vaktumīdṛśam ।। 7.11.10 ॥

translations.english: Then Ravana spoke to his maternal grandfather, who was present, saying, "Kubera, the lord of wealth, is our preceptor; you ought not to speak such things."
translations.hindi: एवं विभीपणस्यापि स्वगस्थस्येव नन्दने | © i ~ Ee दशं वषसहसाश गतान [नयतात्सनः | & ॥ इस प्रकार तप करते हुए विभीषण के दस सहस्त्र (हजार) वर्ष बेसे ही बीते, जेसे स्वग निवासी के नन्दनवन में बीतते है ६ || र » ~ दश वषस्हस्र तु निराहारो दशाननः । पूर ची Q २ ८ दु ण वष सहसे तु शिरश्चाग्री जुहाव सः

verses.sloka: साम्नापि राक्षसेन्द्रेण प्रत्याख्यातो गरीयसा ।किञ्चिन्नाह तदा रक्षो ज्ञात्वा तस्य चकीर्षितम् ।। ७.११.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: sāmnāpi rākṣasendreṇa pratyākhyāto garīyasā ।kiñcinnāha tadā rakṣo jñātvā tasya cakīrṣitam ।। 7.11.11 ॥

translations.english: Even though the venerable maternal grandfather was rejected by the superior lord of Rakshasas (Ravana) with gentle words, the Rakshasa (grandfather) then said nothing, understanding Ravana's intention.

verses.sloka: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य वसन्तं रावणं ततः ।उक्तवन्तं तथा वाक्यं दशग्रीवं निशाचरः ।। ७.११.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: kasyacittvatha kālasya vasantaṁ rāvaṇaṁ tataḥ ।uktavantaṁ tathā vākyaṁ daśagrīvaṁ niśācaraḥ ।। 7.11.12 ॥

translations.english: Then, after some time, while Ravana was residing there, the night-wanderer (Prahasta) addressed Ravana, who had spoken such words.

verses.sloka: प्रहस्तः प्रश्रितं वाक्यमिदमाह स कारणम् ।। ७.११.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: prahastaḥ praśritaṁ vākyamidamāha sa kāraṇam ।। 7.11.13 ॥

translations.english: Prahasta then spoke these humble and reasonable words.
translations.hindi: ब्रह्मा जी प्रसज्ञ होकर सब देवताओं के साथ लिए उसके पास जा बोले--हे दश्रीब ! से तेरे ऊपर प्रसन्न हू

verses.sloka: दशग्रीव महाबाहो नार्हस्त्वं वक्तुमीदृशम् ।सौभ्रात्रं नास्ति शूराणां शृणु चेदं वचो मम ।। ७.११.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: daśagrīva mahābāho nārhastvaṁ vaktumīdṛśam ।saubhrātraṁ nāsti śūrāṇāṁ śṛṇu cedaṁ vaco mama ।। 7.11.14 ॥

translations.english: O mighty-armed Ravana, you ought not to speak such things, for brotherhood does not exist among heroes; therefore, listen to my words.
translations.hindi: हे धर्मज्ञ ! तुझे जो बर सांगना हो शीघ्र माँग। हम तेरे लिए क्या करें, जिससे तेरा परिश्रम व्यथ न जाय

verses.sloka: अदितिश्च दितिश्चैव भगिन्यौ सहिते हि ते ।भार्ये परमरूपिण्यौ कश्यपस्य प्रजापतेः ।। ७.११.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: aditiśca ditiścaiva bhaginyau sahite hi te ।bhārye paramarūpiṇyau kaśyapasya prajāpateḥ ।। 7.11.15 ॥

translations.english: Aditi and Diti, two sisters of supreme beauty, were indeed the wives of Prajapati Kashyapa.
translations.hindi: यह सन कर रावण हषित हुआ ओर सीस नवा कर एवं प्रणाम कर हर्ष से गदूगद हो, बोले

verses.sloka: अदितिर्जनयामास देवांस्त्रिभुवनेश्वरान् ।दितिस्त्वजनयत्पुत्रान्कश्यपस्यात्मसम्भवान् ।। ७.११.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: aditirjanayāmāsa devāṁstribhuvaneśvarān ।ditistvajanayatputrānkaśyapasyātmasambhavān ।। 7.11.16 ॥

translations.english: Aditi gave birth to the gods, who became the lords of the three worlds, while Diti bore sons who were also born from Kashyapa.
translations.hindi: हे भगवन्‌ ! प्राणियों को सदा प्रत्यु का भय जितना सताया करता है, उतना कोई भय उन्हें नहीं सताता, क्योंकि मत्यु से बढ़ कर प्राणियों का और दूसरा शत्रु नहीं हे । अतः मृत्यु भय से बचने के लिए मुझे आप बरदान में अमरत्व दें

verses.sloka: दैत्यानां किल धर्मज्ञ पुरीयं सवनार्णवा ।सपर्वता मही वीर ते ऽभवन्प्रभविष्णवः ।। ७.११.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: daityānāṁ kila dharmajña purīyaṁ savanārṇavā ।saparvatā mahī vīra te 'bhavanprabhaviṣṇavaḥ ।। 7.11.17 ॥

translations.english: O knower of Dharma and O hero, this entire earth, with its forests, oceans, and mountains, was indeed the realm of the powerful Daityas.
translations.hindi: ग्री RR तिमि रिति ९? शी १ 0णणा " देशी! सर! ६५ यह सुन कर ब्रह्म जी बोले कि, ऐसा नहीं हो सकता अर्थात्‌ पूरा पूरा अमरत्व तुझे नहीं मिल सकता। अतः तू और कोई रदान साँग

verses.sloka: निहत्य तांस्तु समरे विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ।देवानां वशमानीतं त्रैलोक्यमिदमव्ययम् ।। ७.११.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: nihatya tāṁstu samare viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ।devānāṁ vaśamānītaṁ trailokyamidamavyayam ।। 7.11.18 ॥

translations.english: However, the powerful Vishnu, having slain them in battle, brought this imperishable three worlds under the control of the gods.
translations.hindi: हे राम ! लोककर्ता ब्रह्मा जी ने जव यह कहा; तब। रावण उनके सामने खड़ा हो ओर हाथ जोड़ कर, बोला

verses.sloka: नैतदेको भवानेव करिष्यति विपर्ययम् ।सुरासुरैराचरितं तत्कुरुष्व वचो मम ।। ७.११.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: naitadeko bhavāneva kariṣyati viparyayam ।surāsurairācaritaṁ tatkuruṣva vaco mama ।। 7.11.19 ॥

translations.english: You alone will not be able to reverse this established order, which has been practiced by both gods and asuras, so please heed my advice.
translations.hindi: जब दसवाँ सहन वर्ष पूरा हुआ; तब उसने अपना: दसधा सिर भी.काट कर अग्न में होमना चाहा, तब उसके खामने ' ब्रह्मा जी प्रकट हुए

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना ।चिन्तयित्वा मुहूर्तं वै बाढमित्येव सो ऽब्रवीत् ।। ७.११.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā ।cintayitvā muhūrtaṁ vai bāḍhamityeva so 'bravīt ।। 7.11.20 ॥

translations.english: Thus addressed, Ravana, with his inner self delighted, thought for a moment and then said, "Very well."
translations.hindi: हे देवपूजित ! इनके अतिरिक्त अन्य ग्राणियों की मुझे चिन्ता या भय नहीं है । मनुष्यादि को तो में चुणबत्‌ समता हूँ

verses.sloka: स तु तेनैव हर्षेण तस्मिन्नहनि वीर्यवान् ।वनं गतो दशग्रीवः सह तैः क्षणदाचरैः ।। ७.११.२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu tenaiva harṣeṇa tasminnahani vīryavān ।vanaṁ gato daśagrīvaḥ saha taiḥ kṣaṇadācaraiḥ ।। 7.11.21 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, on that very day, the powerful Ravana, filled with that joy, went to the forest with those night-wanderers.
translations.hindi: जब राक्षस दशग्रीव ने यह कहा, तव देवताओं सहित खड़े हुए पितामह ब्रह्मा जी बोले

verses.sloka: त्रिकूटस्थः स तु तदा दशग्रीवो निशाचरः ।प्रेषयामास दौत्येन प्रहस्तं वाक्यकोविदम् ।। ७.११.२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: trikūṭasthaḥ sa tu tadā daśagrīvo niśācaraḥ ।preṣayāmāsa dautyena prahastaṁ vākyakovidam ।। 7.11.22 ॥

translations.english: Then, Ravana, the night-wanderer, who was situated on Trikuta mountain, sent Prahasta, who was skilled in speech, as an envoy.

verses.sloka: प्रहस्त शीघ्रं गच्छ त्वं ब्रूहि नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवम् ।वचसा मम वित्तेशं सामपूर्वमिदं वचः ।। ७.११.२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: prahasta śīghraṁ gaccha tvaṁ brūhi nairṛtapuṅgavam ।vacasā mama vitteśaṁ sāmapūrvamidaṁ vacaḥ ।। 7.11.23 ॥

translations.english: "O Prahasta, go quickly and tell the lord of wealth, the chief of the Rakshasas, these conciliatory words from me."
translations.hindi: उससे फिर बोले-हे अनघ ! में तेरे ऊपर बहुत प्रसन्न हू, अतः में अपनी ओर से भी तुझे वर देता हूँ कि जिन अप सिरों को काट कर, तूने आग में होम दिआ हे

verses.sloka: इयं लङ्का पुरी राजन्राक्षसानां महात्मनाम् ।त्वया निवेशिता सौम्य नैतद्युक्तं तवानघ ।। ७.११.२४ ॥
verses.transliteration: iyaṁ laṅkā purī rājanrākṣasānāṁ mahātmanām ।tvayā niveśitā saumya naitadyuktaṁ tavānagha ।। 7.11.24 ॥

translations.english: "O King, O gentle one, O sinless one, this city of Lanka, belonging to the great-souled Rakshasas, was established by you, but this is not proper for you."
translations.hindi: हे राक्षस! वे सिर फिर तेरे पूर्ववत्‌ हो जाँयगे । हे सौम्य ! एक ओर भी दुलेभ वर में तुको देता हूँ

verses.sloka: तद्भवान्यदि नो ह्यद्य दद्यादतुलविक्रम ।कृता भवेन्मम प्रीतिर्धुर्मश्चैवानुपालितः ।। ७.११.२५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tadbhavānyadi no hyadya dadyādatulavikrama ।kṛtā bhavenmama prītirdhurmaścaivānupālitaḥ ।। 7.11.25 ॥

translations.english: O unequalled in valor, if you would indeed give it to us today, my satisfaction would be complete, and my duty would also be fulfilled.

verses.sloka: स तु गत्वा पुरीं लङ्कां धनदेन सुरक्षिताम् ।अब्रवीत्परमोदारं वित्तपालमिदं वचः ।। ७.११.२६ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu gatvā purīṁ laṅkāṁ dhanadena surakṣitām ।abravītparamodāraṁ vittapālamidaṁ vacaḥ ।। 7.11.26 ॥

translations.english: Having arrived at the city of Lanka, which was well-protected by Kubera, the messenger then spoke these words to the most generous lord of wealth.
translations.hindi: आग में होमे हुए सिर पूर्ववत्‌ निकल आए | हे राम ! ब्रह्मा जी इस प्रकार दशग्नीव से कह कर

verses.sloka: प्रेषितो ऽहं तव भ्रात्रा दशग्रीवेण सुव्रत ।त्वत्समीपं महाबाहो सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वर ।। ७.११.२७ ॥
verses.transliteration: preṣito 'haṁ tava bhrātrā daśagrīveṇa suvrata ।tvatsamīpaṁ mahābāho sarvaśastrabhṛtāṁ vara ।। 7.11.27 ॥

translations.english: O one of good vows, O mighty-armed, O best among all weapon-bearers, I have been sent to your presence by your brother, Dashagriva.
translations.hindi: ्रह्म,.जी{विभीषण से बोले- हे.. वत्स विभीषण ! मैं तेरी धर्मबुद्धि देख तुझ पर प्रसन्न हॅ । अतः हे धमोत्मन्‌ ! हे सूत्रतः! तू वर माँगः। तब धर्मात्मा बिभीषण ने।हाथ जोड़ कर कहा

verses.sloka: तच्छ्रूयतां महाप्राज्ञ सर्वशास्त्रविशारद ।वचनं मम वित्तेश यद्ब्रवीति दशाननः ।। ७.११.२८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tacchrūyatāṁ mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada ।vacanaṁ mama vitteśa yadbravīti daśānanaḥ ।। 7.11.28 ॥

translations.english: O greatly wise one, O expert in all scriptures, O lord of wealth, please listen to my message, which Dashanana (Ravana) conveys.

verses.sloka: इयं किल पुरी रम्या सुमालिप्रमुखैः पुरा ।भुक्तपूर्वा विशालाक्ष राक्षसैर्भीमविक्रमैः ।। ७.११.२९ ॥
verses.transliteration: iyaṁ kila purī ramyā sumālipramukhaiḥ purā ।bhuktapūrvā viśālākṣa rākṣasairbhīmavikramaiḥ ।। 7.11.29 ॥

translations.english: O wide-eyed one, this beautiful city was indeed formerly inhabited by Rakshasas of terrible valor, led by Sumali and others.

verses.sloka: तेन विज्ञाप्यते सो ऽयं साम्प्रतं विश्रवात्मज ।तदेषा दीयतां तात याचतस्तस्य सामतः ।। ७.११.३० ॥
verses.transliteration: tena vijñāpyate so 'yaṁ sāmprataṁ viśravātmaja ।tadeṣā dīyatāṁ tāta yācatastasya sāmataḥ ।। 7.11.30 ॥

translations.english: Prahasta requests Kubera, the son of Vishrava, to peacefully hand over Lanka to Ravana, who is now asking for it.
translations.hindi: हे सुब्रत ! यदि आप सुझ पर प्रसन्न हैं और सुके वर ही देना चाहते हैं, तो आप मुझे यह वर दें कि, दारुण विपत्ति पड़ने पर भी, मेरी बुद्धि धर्म ही,में बनी रहे

verses.sloka: प्रहस्तादभिसंश्रुत्य देवो वैश्रवणो वचः ।प्रत्युवाच प्रहस्तं तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः ।। ७.११.३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: prahastādabhisaṁśrutya devo vaiśravaṇo vacaḥ ।pratyuvāca prahastaṁ taṁ vākyaṁ vākyaviśāradaḥ ।। 7.11.31 ॥

translations.english: The god Vaishravana, who was skilled in speech, having heard Prahasta's words, replied to him.

verses.sloka: दत्ता ममेयं पित्रा तु लङ्का शून्या निशाचरैः ।निवासिते च मे यक्षैर्दानमानादिभिर्गुणैः ।। ७.११.३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: dattā mameyaṁ pitrā tu laṅkā śūnyā niśācaraiḥ ।nivāsite ca me yakṣairdānamānādibhirguṇaiḥ ।। 7.11.32 ॥

translations.english: Kubera stated that his father had given him this Lanka, which was empty of Rakshasas, and he had settled it with Yakshas through various means like gifts and honors.

verses.sloka: ब्रूहि गच्छ दशग्रीवं पुरं राज्यं च यन्मम ।तवाप्येतन्महाबाहो भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यमकण्टकम् ।। ७.११.३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: brūhi gaccha daśagrīvaṁ puraṁ rājyaṁ ca yanmama ।tavāpyetanmahābāho bhuṅkṣva rājyamakaṇṭakam ।। 7.11.33 ॥

translations.english: Kubera instructed Prahasta to go and tell Ravana that the city and kingdom which were his, were now also Ravana's, and he should enjoy this unhindered kingdom, O mighty-armed one.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि जिनका धर्म में अनुराग है या जो धर्मनिष्ठ हैं उनके लिए कुछ सी दुलेभ नहीं है | यह सुन व्रह्मा जी प्रसन्न हो, फिर विभीषण से बोले

verses.sloka: एवमुक्त्वा धनाध्यक्षो जगाम पितुरन्तिकम् ।। ७.११.३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā dhanādhyakṣo jagāma piturantikam ।। 7.11.34 ॥

translations.english: Having spoken thus, Kubera, the lord of wealth, went to his father's presence.
translations.hindi: हे वत्स ! धर्मिष्ठ तो तुम हो ही ! इसके अतिरिक्त तुम : जैसा होना चाहते, हो, वैसे ही हो जाओगे। हे शत्रुनाशी ! राक्षसकुल में उत्पन्न हो कर भी

verses.sloka: अभिवाद्य गुरुं प्राह रावणस्य यदीप्सितम् ।एष तात दशग्रीवो दूतं प्रेषितवान्मम ।। ७.११.३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: abhivādya guruṁ prāha rāvaṇasya yadīpsitam ।eṣa tāta daśagrīvo dūtaṁ preṣitavānmama ।। 7.11.35 ॥

translations.english: Having saluted his father, Kubera informed him of Ravana's demand, saying, "O father, Dashagriva has sent a messenger to me with his desire."

verses.sloka: दीयतां नगरी लङ्का पूर्वं रक्षोगणोषिता ।मयात्र यदनुष्ठेयं तन्ममाचक्ष्व सुव्रत ।। ७.११.३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: dīyatāṁ nagarī laṅkā pūrvaṁ rakṣogaṇoṣitā ।mayātra yadanuṣṭheyaṁ tanmamācakṣva suvrata ।। 7.11.36 ॥

translations.english: Kubera further stated, "Let the city of Lanka, formerly inhabited by Rakshasas, be given to him; please tell me, O revered one, what I should do in this situation."
translations.hindi: उस समय उनके साथ जो देवता थे, वे हाथ जोंड़कर उनसे बोले-हे त्रह्मन्‌ ! आप कुस्भकण को वर न दें

verses.sloka: ब्रह्मर्षिस्त्वेवमुक्तो ऽसौ विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः ।प्राञ्जलिं धनदं प्राह शृणु पुत्र वचो मम ।। ७.११.३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: brahmarṣistvevamukto 'sau viśravā munipuṅgavaḥ ।prāñjaliṁ dhanadaṁ prāha śṛṇu putra vaco mama ।। 7.11.37 ॥

translations.english: Thus addressed, the Brahmarshi Vishrava, the foremost among sages, spoke to Kubera, who stood with folded hands, saying, "Listen, O son, to my words."
translations.hindi: क्योंकि आप जानते ही हैँ कि, वर पाए विना ही यह दुष्ट तीनों लोकों को सताया करता है । नन्दनवन में सात अप्सरा ओर इन्द्र के दस टहलुओं को

verses.sloka: दशग्रीवो महाबाहुरुक्तवान्मम सन्निधौ ।मया निर्भर्त्सितश्चासीद्बहुशोक्तः सुदुर्मतिः ।। ७.११.३८ ॥
verses.transliteration: daśagrīvo mahābāhuruktavānmama sannidhau ।mayā nirbhartsitaścāsīdbahuśoktaḥ sudurmatiḥ ।। 7.11.38 ॥

translations.english: Vishrava recounted that the mighty-armed, evil-minded Dashagriva had spoken to him in his presence, and he had repeatedly rebuked and admonished him.
translations.hindi: इसने खा डाला है । इसके खाए हुए ऋषियों और मनुष्यां की तो गिनती हो ही नहीं सकती। विना बर पाए ही जब इसकी ऐसी करतूतें देखने में आती हैं

verses.sloka: स क्रोधेन मया चोक्तो ध्वंसते च पुनः पुनः ।श्रेयो ऽभियुक्तं धर्म्यं च शृणु पुत्र वचो मम ।। ७.११.३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa krodhena mayā cokto dhvaṁsate ca punaḥ punaḥ ।śreyo 'bhiyuktaṁ dharmyaṁ ca śṛṇu putra vaco mama ।। 7.11.39 ॥

translations.english: Vishrava continued, "Though I spoke to him with anger, warning him that he would repeatedly perish, now listen, O son, to my words which are conducive to your welfare and righteousness."

verses.sloka: वरप्रदानसम्मूढो मान्या ऽमान्यान् स दुर्मतिः ।न वेत्ति मम शापाच्च प्रकृतिं दारुणां गतः ।। ७.११.४० ॥
verses.transliteration: varapradānasammūḍho mānyā 'mānyān sa durmatiḥ ।na vetti mama śāpācca prakṛtiṁ dāruṇāṁ gataḥ ।। 7.11.40 ॥

translations.english: Bewildered by the boons, that evil-minded one does not distinguish between the respectable and the disrespectful, and furthermore, he has attained a terrible nature due to my curse.
translations.hindi: इससे लोकों का कल्याण होगा और इसका भी मान बना रहेगा । जब देबताओं ने इस प्रकार कहा, तब पद्मसम्भव ब्रह्मा जी ने सरस्वती देवी का स्मरण किआ

verses.sloka: तस्माद्गच्छ महाबाहो कैलासं धरणीधरम् ।निवेशय निवासार्थं त्यक्त्वा लङ्कां सहानुगः ।। ७.११.४१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmādgaccha mahābāho kailāsaṁ dharaṇīdharam ।niveśaya nivāsārthaṁ tyaktvā laṅkāṁ sahānugaḥ ।। 7.11.41 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, go to the mountain Kailasa, abandon Lanka, and establish your residence there with your followers.
translations.hindi: उत्तरका स्मरण करते ही सरस्वती जी ब्रह्मा जी के पास आ उपस्थित हुई और पास खडी हो, हाथ जोड़े हुए त्रह्मा जी से बोलीं

verses.sloka: तत्र मन्दाकिनी रम्या नदीनामुत्तमा नदी ।काञ्चनैः सूर्यसङ्काशैः पङ्कजैः संवृतोदका ।। ७.११.४२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatra mandākinī ramyā nadīnāmuttamā nadī ।kāñcanaiḥ sūryasaṅkāśaiḥ paṅkajaiḥ saṁvṛtodakā ।। 7.11.42 ॥

translations.english: There flows the beautiful Mandakini river, the best among rivers, whose waters are covered with golden lotuses shining like the sun.
translations.hindi: हे देव ! में यहाँ आ गई हूँ, कहिए क्या आज्ञा हे? सरस्वती को उपस्थित देख, ब्रह्मा जी ने उनसे कहा

verses.sloka: कुमुदैरुत्पलैश्चैव तथा ऽन्यैश्च सुगन्धिभिः ।। ७.११.४३ ॥
verses.transliteration: kumudairutpalaiścaiva tathā 'nyaiśca sugandhibhiḥ ।। 7.11.43 ॥

translations.english: Its waters are also covered with white water lilies, blue lotuses, and other fragrant flowers.
translations.hindi: हे भारती ! देवताओं की कामना के अनुसार, तुम इस राक्षस की जिह्वा पर बेठ कर इससे कहलाओ । “जो आज्ञा कह कर, देवी सरस्वती कुम्भकणा के मुख सें पेठ गई । तब ब्रह्मा जी ने कुम्भकण से कहा

verses.sloka: तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः साप्सरोरगकिंनराः ।विहारशीलाः सततं रमन्ते सर्वदा ऽ ऽश्रिताः ।। ७.११.४४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sāpsaroragakiṁnarāḥ ।vihāraśīlāḥ satataṁ ramante sarvadā ' 'śritāḥ ।। 7.11.44 ॥

translations.english: Gods, along with Gandharvas, Apsaras, Uragas, and Kinnaras, constantly reside there, always delighting in recreation.
translations.hindi: हे महाबलवान कुम्भकरण ! तुम जो वर चाहते हो सो माँग लों । ब्रह्मा जी का यह वचन सुन कुम्भकण बोला

verses.sloka: न हि क्षमं तवानेन वैरं धनद रक्षसा ।जानीषे हि यथा ऽनेन लब्धः परमको वरः ।। ७.११.४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: na hi kṣamaṁ tavānena vairaṁ dhanada rakṣasā ।jānīṣe hi yathā 'nena labdhaḥ paramako varaḥ ।। 7.11.45 ॥

translations.english: O Kubera, it is indeed not proper for you to have enmity with this demon, for you know well how he has obtained a supreme boon.

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तो गृहीत्वा ऽ ऽशु तद्वचः पितृगौरवात् ।सदारपुत्रः सामान्यः सवाहनधनो गतः ।। ७.११.४६ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamukto gṛhītvā ' 'śu tadvacaḥ pitṛgauravāt ।sadāraputraḥ sāmānyaḥ savāhanadhano gataḥ ।। 7.11.46 ॥

translations.english: Thus spoken to, Kubera, out of respect for his father, quickly accepted his words and departed with his wife, sons, retinue, vehicles, and wealth.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार तेजस्वी सब भाई वर प्राप्त कर, उस श्लेष्मा- न्तक£& वन में, जहाँ उनके पिता तप किआ। करते थे, चले गए और वहाँ सखपूर्वक रहने लगे

verses.sloka: प्रहस्तो ऽथ दशग्रीवं गत्वा वचनमब्रवीत् ।प्रहृष्टात्मा महात्मानं सहामात्यं सहानुजम् ।। ७.११.४७ ॥
verses.transliteration: prahasto 'tha daśagrīvaṁ gatvā vacanamabravīt ।prahṛṣṭātmā mahātmānaṁ sahāmātyaṁ sahānujam ।। 7.11.47 ॥

translations.english: Then Prahasta, with a joyful heart, went to the great-souled Dashagriva, who was with his ministers and younger brothers, and spoke these words.
translations.hindi: जब सरस्वती ने कुम्भकण को छोड़ दिआ, तब उसे चेत हुआ । तब तो बह दुष्ट कुम्भकण दुःखी हो सोचने लगा

verses.sloka: शून्या सा नगरी लङ्का त्यक्त्त्वैनां धनदो गतः ।प्रविश्य तां सहास्माभिः स्वधर्मं प्रतिपालय ।। ७.११.४८ ॥
verses.transliteration: śūnyā sā nagarī laṅkā tyakttvaināṁ dhanado gataḥ ।praviśya tāṁ sahāsmābhiḥ svadharmaṁ pratipālaya ।। 7.11.48 ॥

translations.english: That city of Lanka is now empty, as Kubera has abandoned it and departed; therefore, enter that city with us and govern according to your own duty.
translations.hindi: कि हाय मेरे मुख से ऐसा वचन क्यों निकला । मझे जान पड़ता हे कि, उस समय देवताओं ने आ कर मझे मोहित कर दिआ था

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रहस्तेन महाबलः ।विवेश नगरीं लङ्कां भ्रातृभिः सबलानुगैः ।। ७.११.४९ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvaḥ prahastena mahābalaḥ ।viveśa nagarīṁ laṅkāṁ bhrātṛbhiḥ sabalānugaiḥ ।। 7.11.49 ॥

translations.english: Thus spoken to by Prahasta, the mighty Dashagriva entered the city of Lanka with his brothers, army, and followers.

verses.sloka: धनदेन परित्यक्तां सुविभक्तमहापथाम् ।आरुरोह स देवारिः स्वर्गं देवाधिपो यथा ।। ७.११.५० ॥
verses.transliteration: dhanadena parityaktāṁ suvibhaktamahāpathām ।āruroha sa devāriḥ svargaṁ devādhipo yathā ।। 7.11.50 ॥

translations.english: Ravana, the enemy of the gods, ascended to that city (Lanka), which had well-divided great roads and had been abandoned by Kubera, just as Indra ascends to heaven.

verses.sloka: स चाभिषिक्तः क्षणदाचरैस्तदा निवेशयामास पुरीं दशाननः ।निकामपूर्णा च बभूव सा पुरी निशाचरैर्नीलबलाहकोपमैः ।। ७.११.५१ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa cābhiṣiktaḥ kṣaṇadācaraistadā niveśayāmāsa purīṁ daśānanaḥ ।nikāmapūrṇā ca babhūva sā purī niśācarairnīlabalāhakopamaiḥ ।। 7.11.51 ॥

translations.english: After being crowned by the Rakshasas, Ravana then populated that city, and it became completely filled with night-wanderers resembling dark clouds.

verses.sloka: धनेश्वरस्त्वथ पितृवाक्यगौरवान्न्यवेशयच्छशिविमले गिरौ पुरीम् ।स्वलङ्कृतैर्भवनवरैर्विभूषितां पुरन्दरस्वेव तदा ऽमरावतीम् ।। ७.११.५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: dhaneśvarastvatha pitṛvākyagauravānnyaveśayacchaśivimale girau purīm ।svalaṅkṛtairbhavanavarairvibhūṣitāṁ purandarasveva tadā 'marāvatīm ।। 7.11.52 ।।

translations.english: But then Kubera, out of respect for his father's words, established a city on the moon-bright mountain (Kailasa), adorned with well-decorated excellent mansions, just like Indra's Amaravati. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकादशः सर्गः ।। 11 ।। Thus ends the eleventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
